technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with RSI and MACD crossovers, but intermediate/long-term structure is weak (below 50/200 MAs, Ichimoku cloud), ADX lacks trend confirmation, and sector provides no tailwind—suitable only for tactical short-term swing with tight risk management.

fundamental.summary: USB shows weak fundamental signals with no insider/institutional activity, zero government contracts, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 82 days; moderate lobbying spend provides limited conviction.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signal from junior member with small amounts; fear sentiment (40) presents contrarian opportunity but insufficient conviction to override neutral market positioning.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (277.6), NFP event today, and negative macro score (-7) create severe headwinds for financials; earnings in 82 days provides no near-term relief.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI bullish, MACD crossover up, Supertrend bullish) with price near support (34.605) offers tactical swing entry in fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is in crisis (VIX 277.6, inverted yield curve, high credit spreads, NFP event today) with price structurally weak (below 50/200 MAs, below Ichimoku cloud, no ADX trend confirmation), fundamentals are weak (score 3), and earnings risk is high in 82 days—momentum alone insufficient to overcome systemic headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI bullish, MACD crossover, Supertrend) offers tactical appeal at support, but macro crisis environment (VIX 277.6, inverted yield curve, NFP event today) and structural weakness (below 50/200 MAs, Ichimoku cloud) create unacceptable risk-reward for swing trade.
decision.primary_risk: Macro shock from NFP event today combined with crisis VIX and inverted yield curve could trigger sharp reversal below support, invalidating momentum setup and exposing swing trade to gap-down risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical momentum insufficient to overcome macro/fundamental headwinds
